meteor.name: 焚星坠落
meteor.circle: Only this skill uses the approved orange-red double engraved circle. Footprint and circle enlarge together.
meteor.perTargetDamage: Unchanged for this review. A wider area can include additional targets; production balance remains pending.

mergedField.name: 焚焰火域
mergedField.proposal: One advancing flame front opens into a single fixed rectangular burning field; continuous damage and slowing while inside.
mergedField.damageBudget: One new combined budget, not a sum of both old skills. Final damage and cooldown require later balance work.
mergedField.placement: Placed at aim point; does not physically block navigation. Keep at most one field; replacement does not stack.
mergedField.previewLimit: Uses the existing FIR_05 spread and damage events as an animation carrier. The proposed slow and complete combined skill rules are not implemented.

newJet.name: 烈焰喷流
newJet.proposal: Gather at the real casting hand; continuously feed a dense three-dimensional fire column forward; close the source and retract on release.
newJet.aiming: Choose direction on cast; preview holds it steady. No automatic target-to-target tracking or ground magic circle.
newJet.gameplayIntent: Good against enemies aligned in front; requires a brief stationary cast. Damage stops if the channel is interrupted. Cannot penetrate terrain.
newJet.previewLimit: Existing FIR_04 cast acts as a zero-damage animation carrier. The new channel, repeated damage, collision and interruption rules are proposed only. Existing native spell pose is held through the channel and then recovered.
